height_zero.reason: After the p7/p17 spatial divisibility gates, every target is excluded by integrality, evenness, K12 minimum four, or the minimum-twelve mod-three pairing radical.

local_mirror_norms.proof: Put pi=sqrt(2), a=12*pi-13, delta7=3+pi and delta17=5-2*pi. Then a=(pi-1)*delta7*delta17. For a primitive root r=(x,y), q(r) divides 2I(r), I(r)=(a*x,(y,K12^2)). Away from pi, 3, delta7 and delta17 the spatial Gram is unimodular, so no prime can divide q. At each coefficient prime delta7,delta17 the exponent is zero or one, and exponent one forces y into that prime times K12^2. At 3 the elementary Smith form 1^12,3^12 gives exponent zero or one; exponent one forces every spatial pairing to be divisible by 3. At pi the spatial lattice is even and unimodular, so the only exponents are zero and two. The four local choices are independent. Since Z[sqrt(2)] has class number one and every totally-positive unit is a square, the sixteen products of 1 or 2, optionally 3, delta7 and delta17, are the complete canonical primitive norm classes.
